name: Marudai Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Marudai Food Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hams and sausages, cooked processed food, and meat products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Processed Food Business and Fresh Meat Business segments. The company offers hams, sausages, wiener, prosciutto, roast pork, frank, hamburger seal and meatballs, bacon, and fish and meat products. It also provides chicken dishes, Korean food ingredients, cooking soup and sauce, curry, meat side dishes, frozen food, and snack products. In addition, the company offers beef, pork, and chicken meat products; and desserts and beverages. The company offers its products through mass retailers and restaurants.
